## Virta Health - Senior Software Engineer – Client Lifecycle

🔗 [Apply](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/virtahealth/5bbeb7cb-870a-48c9-825e-934e5a189fc0)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building Virta Health’s healthcare quote-to-cash systems. Developing Go services for billing, claims, reconciliation, and client operations.
Senior Software Engineer building Virta Health’s healthcare quote-to-cash systems
- Salary: $161,500 - $232,500 per year
- Tech stack: Cloud, Google Cloud Platform, React, SDLC, SQL, TypeScript, Go
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors H1B visas. Treat as a small scoring bonus, not a guarantee for this role.
- Lead projects end to end from ambiguous stakeholder problem through design, review, production, and ownership
- Build and extend Go services supporting quote-to-cash, including contract and pricing configuration, billable event generation, subscription and invoice management, and claims submission
- Expand assertion and reconciliation frameworks across Salesforce, Zuora, and clinical data
- Improve reconciliation and billing data used by health plan and employer partners
- Design self-service tools for finance, RCM, and client operations to configure contracts, correct data, and run bulk changes
- Apply AI where appropriate
- Participate in design and code reviews and mentor engineers
- Deliver a production pull request within the first 30 days
- 5+ years building and operating backend services in production, in Go or another statically typed language
- Experience with event-driven architectures, including eventual consistency, ordering, idempotency, and systems that disagree with each other
- Strong SQL and comfort working across application code and the analytics layer
- Experience owning a system where correctness had consequences outside the company, such as billing, payments, claims, ledgers, or regulated reporting
- Track record of working directly with non-engineering stakeholders and translating finance or operations problems into designs
- Experience with a major cloud platform; Virta uses GCP
- Experience working with AI to accelerate development workflows and enhance the SDLC
- Experience in frontend development with React and TypeScript

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building Virta Health’s healthcare quote-to-cash systems. Developing Go services for billing, claims, reconciliation, and client operations.
Senior Software Engineer building Virta Health’s healthcare quote-to-cash systems
Role description:
• Lead projects end to end from ambiguous stakeholder problem through design, review, production, and ownership
• Build and extend Go services supporting quote-to-cash, including contract and pricing configuration, billable event generation, subscription and invoice management, and claims submission
• Expand assertion and reconciliation frameworks across Salesforce, Zuora, and clinical data
• Improve reconciliation and billing data used by health plan and employer partners
• Design self-service tools for finance, RCM, and client operations to configure contracts, correct data, and run bulk changes
• Apply AI where appropriate
• Participate in design and code reviews and mentor engineers
• Deliver a production pull request within the first 30 days
• Develop a test-driven design that survives architecture review within the first 60 days
• Own an ambiguous problem through completion with a product mindset within the first 90 days
Role requirements:
• 5+ years building and operating backend services in production, in Go or another statically typed language
• Experience with event-driven architectures, including eventual consistency, ordering, idempotency, and systems that disagree with each other
• Strong SQL and comfort working across application code and the analytics layer
• Experience owning a system where correctness had consequences outside the company, such as billing, payments, claims, ledgers, or regulated reporting
• Track record of working directly with non-engineering stakeholders and translating finance or operations problems into designs
• Experience with a major cloud platform; Virta uses GCP
• Experience working with AI to accelerate development workflows and enhance the SDLC
• Experience in frontend development with React and TypeScript
• Ability to follow security and privacy procedures for HIPAA-governed patient information
• Legal authorization to work in the United States
• Must not require sponsorship for employment visa status in the United States
Benefits:
• Remote-first work arrangement
• Office hubs in Denver and San Francisco
• Security and privacy training
• AI-powered recruiting process with final hiring decisions made by Virta Health personnel
Tech stack:
Cloud, Google Cloud Platform, React, SDLC, SQL, TypeScript, Go
Company sponsorship flag: sponsorsH1B=true.
